# awesome-design-md

Each folder holds one `DESIGN.md` from [VoltAgent/awesome-design-md](https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-design-md),
copyright (c) 2026 VoltAgent, released under the MIT License (the `LICENSE` file in this folder, which must stay with
the copies). Only the `DESIGN.md` files are copied, unchanged. `SOURCE` records the upstream commit;
`sh framework/design/vendor/awesome-design-md/sync.sh` refreshes them (it only touches this folder).

How styles are picked and applied: [framework/design/README.md](../../README.md).

The files describe the visual language of public websites to inspire a style; the brand names, logos and trademarks
they mention belong to their owners. A restyled application keeps its own name and logo and never presents itself as
one of those sites.
